evidence.quote:
# Generate RSA key
ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "your_email@example.com"

# Generate ED25519 key (recommended)
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your_email@example.com"

# Generate with custom filename
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/id_myserver

# Generate without passphrase (automation)
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N "" -f ~/.ssh/id_deploy

implementation_choices.statement: The supported SSH key-management commands generate persistent key files, including caller-selected key paths.

evidence.quote:
# With key and options
Host production
    HostName prod.example.com
    User deploy
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_prod
    ForwardAgent yes
    
# Jump host (bastion)
Host internal
    HostName 10.0.0.5
    User admin

implementation_choices.statement: Host-specific configuration pairs the production host with its user/key and gives the internal host distinct routing, retaining per-host identity rather than one global destination.
